title: Uncategorized still uses the General Matrix and new parts start in it
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts' and 'See Financial Data'.
  • Use the staging site with the Tiered Pricing release (and the Tiered Pricing QA site too, once it exists); production is not needed.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Open Settings › Categories.
  2. Click Uncategorized's row.
  3. Start a new inventory part from Parts › Inventory.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Uncategorized is listed first, on the General Matrix.

Step 2:

  • Uncategorized's page shows the General Matrix's grid.
  • Its name cannot be renamed.

Step 3:

  • The new part's category reads Uncategorized.
